name: WordPress Hooks & Gutenberg
description: Hooks, filters, REST, AJAX, Gutenberg blocks, theme.json and safe WordPress extension patterns.
author: Free AI Hub 63
ai_context: Be precise about WordPress hooks, priorities, capabilities, nonces, sanitization, escaping, REST permission callbacks, enqueueing, theme.json and Gutenberg APIs. Prefer child-theme/plugin-safe extension points over editing core or vendor files.

quick_actions.label: Find WordPress hook
quick_actions.prompt: Find the best WordPress/WooCommerce hook or extension point for this requirement and provide production-ready code.

quick_actions.label: Build Gutenberg feature
quick_actions.prompt: Implement this feature using native Gutenberg/block theme APIs where practical, including theme.json/templates/patterns or block code as needed.
